verdict.rationale: LocalAI runs models on the user's own hardware: a single binary or Docker container serves the API at localhost:8080, pulls models such as GGUF files, auto-detects local GPUs, and ships a first-class CPU path, so no external inference service is needed. Optional features such as external MCP servers or remote gRPC backends are opt-in. missing for 10: an explicit first-party privacy/no-telemetry statement that prompts and data never leave the device, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fully offline operation.
